## Load the packages
```{r}
#import the libraries
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

library(nlme)
library(DescTools)

library(MASS)
```


## Load the various datasets
```{r}

lsoa_data_new = read.csv("LSOA21.csv")

deprivation_data = read_csv("deprivation_data.csv") # deprivation dataset

#import the various opioid datasets from opioidprescribing.net
lowdose_oxycodone = read.csv("lowdose_oxy.csv")
highdose_oxycodone = read.csv("highdose_oxy.csv")
lowdose_morphine = read.csv("lowdose_morph.csv")
high_morphine = read.csv("highdose_morph.csv")
lowdose_fentanyl = read.csv("lowdose_fentanyl.csv")
highdose_fentanyl = read.csv("highdose_fentanyl.csv")
lowdose_buprenorphine = read.csv("lowdose_buprenorphine.csv")
highdose_buprenorphine = read.csv("highdose_buprenorphine.csv")
highdose_tramadol = read.csv("highdose_tramadol.csv")
lowdose_tramadol = read.csv("lowdose_tramadol.csv")
```

# Load the regional dataset

```{r}

regional_data = read.csv("subicb_to_nhs.csv")

regional_df = regional_data %>%
  dplyr::select(SICBL26CDH, SICBL26NM, NHSER26NM)%>%  # selecting relevant variables
  rename(id = SICBL26CDH,
         subicb = SICBL26NM,
         region = NHSER26NM)

head(regional_df)
```

# working on the LSOA dataset

```{r}
lsoa_new = lsoa_data_new %>%
  dplyr::select(LSOA21CD, SICBL26CDH)%>%  # selecting relevant variables
  rename(lsoa_id = LSOA21CD,
         subicb_id = SICBL26CDH)

head(lsoa_new)
```

# The deprivation score was used instead of the decile to enable aggregation

```{r}

dep_data = deprivation_data %>%
  dplyr::select(`LSOA code (2021)`,`Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Score`, 
         `Income Score (rate)`,
         `Employment Score (rate)`, 
         `Education, Skills and Training Score`,
         `Health Deprivation and Disability Score`,
         `Crime Score`,
         `Barriers to Housing and Services Score`,
         `Living Environment Score`,
         `Total population: mid 2022`)%>%
  
#renaming the variables for readability
  rename(lsoa_id = `LSOA code (2021)`,
         imd_score = `Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Score`,
         income_score = `Income Score (rate)`,
         employment_score = `Employment Score (rate)`,
         education_score = `Education, Skills and Training Score`,
         health_score = `Health Deprivation and Disability Score`,
         housing_score = `Barriers to Housing and Services Score`,
         crime_score = `Crime Score`,
         living_environment_score = `Living Environment Score`,
         total_population = `Total population: mid 2022`)

head(dep_data)
```


## join the lsoa and imd dataset

```{r}
lsoa_to_dep_data = left_join(lsoa_new, dep_data, by = "lsoa_id")

head(lsoa_to_dep_data)
```

#work on the prescription datasets, select relevant variables and rename vaviables

```{r opioid datasets}

#removed the cost of opioids from all datasets

oxy_low = lowdose_oxycodone %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>% 
  rename(oxycodone_low = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

oxy_high = highdose_oxycodone %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost,)%>%
  rename(oxycodone_high = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

morphine_lowdose = lowdose_morphine %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(morphine_lowdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

morphine_highdose = high_morphine %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(morphine_highdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

fentanyl_lowdose = lowdose_fentanyl %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(fentanyl_lowdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

fentanyl_highdose = highdose_fentanyl %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(fentanyl_highdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

buprenorphine_lowdose = lowdose_buprenorphine %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(buprenorphine_lowdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

buprenorphine_highdose = highdose_buprenorphine %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(buprenorphine_highdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

tramadol_highdose = highdose_tramadol %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(tramadol_highdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

tramadol_lowdose = lowdose_tramadol %>%
  dplyr::select(-y_actual_cost, -x_actual_cost)%>%
  rename(tramadol_lowdose = y_items)%>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))
```

# join all the opioid datasets into 1

```{r}
opioid_data <- oxy_low %>%
  left_join(oxy_high,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    morphine_lowdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    morphine_highdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  )  %>%
  left_join(
    fentanyl_lowdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fentanyl_highdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  )  %>%
  left_join(
    buprenorphine_lowdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    buprenorphine_highdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tramadol_highdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tramadol_lowdose,
    by = c("date", "id", "name", "x_items")
  ) 

head(opioid_data)
```

#create a new dataset by computing the mean and standard deviation of the domains of deprivation

```{r}


wtavg_data = lsoa_to_dep_data %>%
  group_by(subicb_id) %>%
  summarise(avgimdscore = round(weighted.mean(imd_score, total_population), 2),
            stdimd = round(sd(imd_score), 2),
            avgincomescore = round(weighted.mean(income_score, w = total_population), 2),
            stdincome = round(sd(income_score), 2),
            avgempscore = round(weighted.mean(employment_score, w = total_population, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            stdemployment = round(sd(employment_score),2),
            avgeduscore = round(weighted.mean(education_score, w = total_population, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            stdeducation = round(sd(education_score), 2),
            avghealthscore = round(weighted.mean(health_score, w = total_population, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            stdhealth = round(sd(health_score), 2),
            avgcrimescore = round(weighted.mean(crime_score, w = total_population, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            stdcrime = round(sd(crime_score), 2),
            avghousingscore = round(weighted.mean(housing_score, w = total_population, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            stdhousing = round(sd(housing_score), 2),
            avgenvironment = round(weighted.mean(living_environment_score, w = total_population, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            stdenvironment = round(sd(living_environment_score), 2)) %>%
  rename(id = subicb_id)

head(wtavg_data)
```

#creating one full dataset of all the datasets

```{r}
all_data_new = left_join(opioid_data, wtavg_data, by = "id")

head(all_data_new)
```

#find the total prescription for each opioid for each sub-ICB 

```{r}
tab2 = all_data_new %>%
  mutate(period = case_when( date >= as.Date("2021-09-01") &
        date <= as.Date("2025-03-01") ~ "Before",

      date >= as.Date("2025-04-01") &
        date <= as.Date("2026-08-01") ~ "After",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )%>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("Before", "After")
    )
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(name, period) %>%
  summarise(
    total_opioid_items    = sum(x_items, na.rm = TRUE),
    oxycodone_low         = sum(oxycodone_low, na.rm = TRUE),
    oxycodone_high        = sum(oxycodone_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    morphine_low          = sum(morphine_lowdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    morphine_high         = sum(morphine_highdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    fentanyl_low          = sum(fentanyl_lowdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    fentanyl_high         = sum(fentanyl_highdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    buprenorphine_low     = sum(buprenorphine_lowdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    buprenorphine_high    = sum(buprenorphine_highdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    tramadol_low          = sum(tramadol_lowdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    tramadol_high         = sum(tramadol_highdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

head(tab2)
```

#compute the rate of prescribtion of each subicb

```{r}
subicb_ratio = tab2%>%
    mutate(
    across(
      oxycodone_low:tramadol_high,
      ~ 1000 * .x / total_opioid_items, 
      .names = "{.col}_ratio"
    )
  )%>%
  
    mutate(
    total_low_ratio  =  ((oxycodone_low + morphine_low + fentanyl_low +
                             buprenorphine_low + tramadol_low) / total_opioid_items)*1000,
    total_high_ratio =  ((oxycodone_high + morphine_high + fentanyl_high +
                             buprenorphine_high + tramadol_high) / total_opioid_items)*1000,
    totalmr =  ((oxycodone_low + morphine_low + fentanyl_low +
                             buprenorphine_low + tramadol_low + oxycodone_high + morphine_high + fentanyl_high +
                             buprenorphine_high + tramadol_high) / total_opioid_items)*1000 
  )
  

head(subicb_ratio)
```

# descriptive statistics of the opioids

```{r}
pct_vars = c("oxycodone_low_ratio", "oxycodone_high_ratio",
              "morphine_low_ratio", "morphine_high_ratio",
              "fentanyl_low_ratio", "fentanyl_high_ratio",
              "buprenorphine_low_ratio", "buprenorphine_high_ratio",
              "tramadol_low_ratio", "tramadol_high_ratio",
              "total_low_ratio", "total_high_ratio",
             "totalmr")

table_summary = subicb_ratio %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(pct_vars),
      list(
        mean   = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd     = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        q1     = ~ quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q3     = ~ quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

table_summary
```

## Objective 1. National time series analysis 

```{r}
national_monthly_total = all_data_new %>%
  group_by(date) %>%  # for monthly aggregation
  summarise(
    across(
      c(x_items,
        oxycodone_low,
        oxycodone_high,
        morphine_lowdose,
        morphine_highdose,
       
        fentanyl_lowdose,
        fentanyl_highdose,
      
        buprenorphine_lowdose,
        buprenorphine_highdose,
        tramadol_lowdose,
        tramadol_highdose
      ),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  mutate(total_opioids = sum(c(oxycodone_low, oxycodone_high, morphine_highdose, morphine_lowdose, tramadol_highdose, tramadol_lowdose, fentanyl_lowdose, fentanyl_highdose, buprenorphine_lowdose, buprenorphine_highdose)),
         all_opioids = sum(x_items),
         ratio = (total_opioids/all_opioids)*1000) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(date, total_opioids, all_opioids, ratio)%>%
  
    mutate(period = case_when( date >= as.Date("2021-09-01") &  #before the update
        date <= as.Date("2025-03-01") ~ "Before",

      date >= as.Date("2025-04-01") &
        date <= as.Date("2026-08-01") ~ "After",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )%>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("Before", "After")
    )
  )


head(national_monthly_total)
```

#Line graph of the national data

```{r}

national_monthly_total %>%
  ggplot(aes (x = date,
              y=ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2025-03-12"), # date of the policy update
             colour = "red",
             linetype = "dashed") +

  
  xlab('Month')+
      ylab(str_wrap('Items for Modified-release Opioids per 1000 opioid items', width = 50))+
      labs(title = 'MR opioid prescription from September 2021 to August 2026')+
      theme_classic()+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text = element_text(size=12),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
            plot.title = element_text(size=12, face = "bold"))
```

#Run a time series regression analysis

```{r}
 national_monthly_totalTS = national_monthly_total %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(time = row_number())%>%
  mutate(mhra_update = if_else(date <= as.Date("2025-03-01"),0,1))%>%
  mutate(time_after = case_when(mhra_update == 1 ~ row_number()-43, TRUE~0))%>%
  dplyr::select(date,ratio,time,mhra_update,time_after)

head(national_monthly_totalTS)
```

# decomposition

```{r}
ts_data = ts(national_monthly_totalTS$ratio, frequency = 12, start = c(2021, 6))
decomp = decompose(ts_data)
plot(decomp)
```

# adjust for seasonality

```{r}
deseasonalised = ts_data - seasonal
deseasonalised
```

# compute the adjusted rate

```{r}
its_data = national_monthly_totalTS %>%
  mutate(rate_adj = as.numeric(deseasonalised))

head(its_data)
```

# Fit segmented regression with AR(1) correlation structure

```{r}
model2_gls = gls(rate_adj ~ time + mhra_update + time_after,
                   data = its_data,
                   correlation = corAR1(form = ~ time),
                   method = "ML")

# View results
summary(model2_gls)
```

## Run the assumption checks

```{r}
# Extract normalized residuals 
acf(residuals(model2_gls, type = "normalized"))
pacf(residuals(model2_gls, type = "normalized"))
```

```{r}
# Test across the first 10 lags using normalized residuals
Box.test(residuals(model2_gls, type = "normalized"), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```


```{r}
# Extract the normalized residuals
norm_res <- residuals(model2_gls, type = "normalized")

# Set up a 1x2 plotting window
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Left Plot: Q-Q Plot
qqnorm(norm_res, main = "Normal Q-Q Plot")
qqline(norm_res, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Right Plot: Histogram with Normal Curve
hist(norm_res, probability = TRUE, main = "Histogram of Residuals", xlab = "Normalized Residuals")
curve(dnorm(x, mean = mean(norm_res), sd = sd(norm_res)), add = TRUE, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

```

```{r}
# Extract normalized residuals and fitted values
norm_res <- residuals(model2_gls, type = "normalized")
fitted_vals <- fitted(model2_gls)

# Create the Residuals vs Fitted plot
plot(fitted_vals, norm_res, 
     xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Normalized Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted Values Plot",
     pch = 19, col = alpha("black", 0.6))
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

# Add a smooth trend line to check for non-linear patterns
lines(lowess(fitted_vals, norm_res), col = "blue", lwd = 2)

```

# First, a descriptive summary of the regions and social deprivation by 5 years period

```{r}
objective2_data <- new_data %>%
  mutate(period = case_when(
    date >= as.Date("2021-09-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-03-01") ~ "Before",
    date >= as.Date("2025-04-01") & date <= as.Date("2026-08-01") ~ "After",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  group_by(date, name, period, region, avgimdscore, avgincomescore, avgempscore, avgeduscore, avghealthscore, avgcrimescore, avghousingscore, avgenvironment) %>%
  summarise(
    mr_items = sum(oxycodone_low + oxycodone_high + morphine_lowdose + morphine_highdose +
                   fentanyl_lowdose + fentanyl_highdose + buprenorphine_lowdose + buprenorphine_highdose +
                   tramadol_lowdose + tramadol_highdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_items = sum(x_items, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Before", "After"))) %>%
  
   mutate(rate = (mr_items / total_items) * 1000)%>%
  
   mutate(
    imd_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgimdscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    income_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgincomescore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    housing_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avghousingscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    environment_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgenvironment), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    health_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avghealthscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )%>%
   mutate(
    crime_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgcrimescore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )%>%
   mutate(
    education_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgeduscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )%>%
   mutate(
    employment_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgempscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )
  
  

head(objective2_data)
```

#plot a time series graph for each NHS region

```{r}
region_order = objective2_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(overall_median = median(rate, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(overall_median)) %>%
  pull(region)

region_plot = objective2_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = region_order)) %>%
  group_by(date, region) %>%
  summarise(rate = median(rate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = rate, colour = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2025-03-01"), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ region) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(20, 150)) +
  labs(title = "MR opioid prescribing by NHS region, September 2021 to August 2026",
       x = "Month", y = "MR opioid items per 1,000 opioid items", , colour = "Region") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

region_plot
```

# Use 12 months before and after the MHRA update to run descriptive analysis and regression analysis #

```{r}
# Building the same statistics for 1 year before and 1 year after

oneyeardiff_data <- new_data %>%
  mutate(period = case_when(
    date >= as.Date("2024-04-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-03-01") ~ "Before",
    date >= as.Date("2025-04-01") & date <= as.Date("2026-03-01") ~ "After",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  group_by(date, name, period, region, avgimdscore, avgincomescore, avgempscore, avgeduscore, avghealthscore, avgcrimescore, avghousingscore, avgenvironment) %>%
  summarise(
    mr_items = sum(oxycodone_low + oxycodone_high + morphine_lowdose + morphine_highdose +
                   fentanyl_lowdose + fentanyl_highdose + buprenorphine_lowdose + buprenorphine_highdose +
                   tramadol_lowdose + tramadol_highdose, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_items = sum(x_items, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Before", "After"))) 
  
  

head(oneyeardiff_data)
```

# collapse the data to have the prescription rate per month per sub-ICB

```{r}
collapsed_oneyear_data <- oneyeardiff_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  group_by(name, period, region, avgimdscore, avgincomescore, avgempscore, avgeduscore, avghealthscore, avgcrimescore, avghousingscore, avgenvironment) %>%
  summarise(
    mr_items = sum(mr_items, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_items = sum(total_items, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Before", "After")),
         region = factor(region))%>%
  
   mutate(rate = (mr_items / total_items) * 1000)%>%
  
   mutate(
    imd_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgimdscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    income_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgincomescore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    housing_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avghousingscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    environment_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgenvironment), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    health_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avghealthscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )%>%
   mutate(
    crime_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgcrimescore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )%>%
   mutate(
    education_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgeduscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )%>%
   mutate(
    employment_quintile_label = factor(ntile(desc(avgempscore), 5),
                                 levels = 1:5,
                                 labels = c("1 - Most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - Least deprived"))
  )

## Check it collapsed correctly
nrow(collapsed_oneyear_data)                                     # should be 214 now (107 x 2)
collapsed_oneyear_data %>% count(name, period) %>% distinct(n)    # should show only the value 1
table(collapsed_oneyear_data$period)
table(collapsed_oneyear_data$region)
```

# Run the neagtive binomial regression for region and domains of deprivation

```{r}
#Did the change vary significantly by region
region_model <- glm.nb(mr_items ~ period * region + offset(log(total_items)), data = collapsed_oneyear_data)

vc_region <- vcovCL(region_model, cluster = collapsed_oneyear_data$name)
ct_region <- coeftest(region_model, vcov. = vc_region)
ci_region <- coefci(region_model, vcov. = vc_region)

irr_region <- tibble(
  term = rownames(ct_region),
  IRR = exp(ct_region[, "Estimate"]),
  lower = exp(ci_region[, 1]),
  upper = exp(ci_region[, 2]),
  p_value = ct_region[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
)
irr_region
```
